title: Estun-Bah Sounds of Beauty CD 2007 Native American Flute Tony Duncan
conditionDescription: Pre-owned. Disc, jewel case and inserts show normal light wear consistent with age and storage. Please review photos for exact condition.
descriptionText:
Estun-Bah - Sounds of Beauty (2007 Tony Duncan Productions).
Native American flute and acoustic guitar.

Estun-Bah: Tony Duncan, flute; Darrin Yazzie, acoustic guitar;
Jeremy Meyers, percussion. Special guests: Ric Flauding, classical
guitar; Kevin Huang, violin; vocals by Eli Secody and Ken Duncan.
Produced by Tony Duncan.

1. Violet
2. Spirit of Mother Earth
3. She Walks Beside Me (featuring Eli Secody)
4. Birds Dancing
5. Touch of Beauty
6. In the Time of Chiefs
7. As the Sun Rises (featuring Eli Secody)
8. Desert Stars
9. Dancing Across the Sky
10. Soaring Eagle
11. Moonlit Journey
12. Native Ways
13. Where have you Gone
14. Words from My Father

Disc, jewel case and pictured inserts are included. You will receive the exact CD pictured.
